description: This file defines the class printDocOptions, which manages various options and settings related to printing documentation in the TestLink project, such as document sections, requirement specifications, test specifications, and execution options.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage and retrieve printing options for documentation, test specifications, requirement specifications, and execution settings in the TestLink project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes arrays of options for documentation, requirement specifications, test specifications, and execution parameters.

methods.name: getDocOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of general documentation options.

methods.name: getTestSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of test specification options.

methods.name: getReqSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of requirement specification options.

methods.name: getExecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of execution options.

methods.name: getAllOptVars
methods.description: Returns an associative array of all options with their checked state normalized to 0 or 1.

methods.name: getJSPrintPreferences
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of all option 'value' identifiers for JavaScript preferences.
